entries.reason: A fresh 17.2.3/17.2.4 creates umbracoEngageAnalyticsUmbracoPageVariant.contentTypeId NOT NULL; an upgrade from 17.2.2 or older keeps it NULL, and 17.2.0-17.2.4 record the same last migration step (verify --mode upgrade 17.2.0 -> 17.2.4: 1 Critical ColumnNullabilityDifferent). No upgraded manifest is stored: detection reports such a database as 'between 17.2.0 and 17.2.2 (upgrade record allows up to 17.2.4)'.

entries.assumption: complete with the published script = complete
entries.reason: Completed with the alignment scripts published in the Engage schema alignment guide (22-10-2026), umbracoEngageAnalyticsUmbracoPageVariant.contentTypeId becomes NOT NULL; the stored complete manifests of these releases keep it NULL. Everything else is identical. Both shapes are real: the stored one is what a database completed at the time looks like. A database completed with the published script matches the 16.3.3 or 17.2.3-17.2.4 complete manifest exactly (same last migration step), so detection reports it as 16.3.3 or as between 17.2.3 and 17.2.4, healthy.
sources: manifests/engage/16.3.3.complete.json and 17.2.3.complete.json (contentTypeId NOT NULL, the shape the published script gives)
